when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

info.about: Customer's name or email, plus at least 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These are checked against the records.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or address?

info.about: Which checking account the customer wants to close and that they also want a new personal savings account
info.ask: Which account would you like to close, and would you also like to open a savings account?

info.about: How many withdrawals the customer expects to make from savings each month
info.ask: About how many withdrawals or transfers out of savings do you expect to make each month?

info.about: The balance the customer can realistically keep in savings, which is checked against each account's ongoing minimum balance
info.ask: How much can you comfortably keep in the account on an ongoing basis?

info.about: Whether the customer needs daily compounding
info.ask: Do you have a preference for how often interest compounds?

info.about: Whether the customer wants a relationship or loyalty APY bonus for holding several Rho-Bank products
info.ask: Is earning a relationship bonus for banking with us important to you?

info.about: Whether the customer wants out-of-network ATM fees rebated
info.ask: Do you use out-of-network ATMs and want those fees rebated?

info.about: Whether the customer wants built-in savings goals tracking
info.ask: Would built-in savings goal tracking be useful to you?

info.about: Any other wishes, such as eco-friendly or premium features, which are weighed against the hard needs above
info.ask: Is there anything else you want from the account?

info.about: The customer's checking and savings accounts: account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, date_opened
Whether the customer wants the opening deposit transferred from checking now
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now?

steps.do: Ask for identifying details before looking at any account
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Look up the customer record by the name or email the customer gave

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email with the email)

steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Check that at least 2 of DOB, email, phone and address match the record. Share no account details until they do.
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and the tenure calculations
steps.quote: The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.

steps.do: Log the verification
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Unlock the account-lookup tool
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve all of the customer's bank accounts
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Check savings eligibility: an active checking account held at least 14 days (use date_opened and the current time), fewer than 5 personal savings accounts, and no negative balances or collections. Note which checking accounts meet the 14-day tenure.
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: If the customer also wants to close a checking account, open the savings account first. Explain why: savings eligibility needs a checking account held at least 14 days, and closing the older checking account first could leave only a newer one that does not qualify. Give the reason; do not simply insist.
steps.if: customer also asked to close a checking account (especially if it is the only checking account with 14+ days tenure)
steps.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: Ask about the savings needs: withdrawals per month, the balance they can keep, compounding, relationship bonus, ATM rebates, savings goals and any other wishes
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Use the rules to rule out accounts that miss a hard need. Recommend the ONE account that meets all needs, giving its exact name ending in 'Account'. For about 12-15 withdrawals, a balance of about $2.5k-$4k, daily compounding, relationship bonus, ATM rebates and goals tracking, that is the Silver Plus Account.
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Unlock the account-opening tool
steps.if: customer accepts the recommendation and eligibility is met
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Open the savings account

arguments.account_class: the confirmed account class, e.g. 'Silver Plus Account'

steps.if: customer accepts the recommendation and eligibility is met
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Unlock and call the transfer tool to move the opening deposit from a checking account the customer is keeping

arguments.amount: the opening deposit confirmed with the customer

steps.quote: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit, or it will be closed
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

rules.rule: Savings eligibility: the customer must have an active checking account held for 14 or more days
rules.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

rules.rule: The customer must hold fewer than 5 personal savings accounts
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: The customer must have no accounts in collections and no negative balances
rules.quote: Customer has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: 15 free withdrawals per month
rules.quote: You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: ongoing minimum balance is $2,500
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: interest compounds daily
rules.quote: Interest is compounded daily to help maximize earnings.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: minimum opening deposit is $1,000
rules.quote: Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: relationship APY bonus of 0.025%
rules.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: ATM fee rebates up to 25 per month
rules.quote: Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: built-in savings goals tracking; it is the only personal savings account whose documents mention this feature
rules.quote: Use the integrated goals tool to set targets, monitor progress, and visualize how contributions accelerate over time.

rules.rule: Silver Account allows only 10 free withdrawals per cycle (15 only for Platinum Rewards Card holders), so it does not fit about 12-15 withdrawals
rules.quote: If you expect frequent withdrawals, consider spacing them to remain within 10 per cycle.

rules.rule: Bronze Account allows only 6 free withdrawals per month
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Green Account (savings), the eco option, allows only 8 free withdrawals per month (15 only for EcoCard holders) and has no goals tracking
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: Gold Account (premium) requires a $10,000 minimum balance; it does not fit customers who cannot keep $10,000
rules.quote: Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.

rules.rule: Platinum Account requires a $50,000 minimum balance (Gold Plus $25,000, Platinum Plus $100,000, Diamond Elite $250,000)
rules.quote: Maintain at least $50,000 to preserve Platinum benefits.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, the chosen savings account is opened with open_bank_account_4821, and the customer has either had the deposit transferred or been told about the 30-day funding deadline.

when.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

info.ask: Which checking account would you like to close?

info.about: Status, balance (current_holdings), date_opened and pending transactions of that account
Debit cards linked to the account being closed

steps.do: Re-read the accounts to confirm the status and balance of the account to close
steps.quote: Verifying pre-closure requirements when closing accounts

steps.do: Check that status is OPEN and there are no pending transactions. Find the tier and fee: Green Account (checking) and Blue Account are MID tier, with a $25 fee if closed within 60 days of opening and a 3-day notice period. If no fee applies, the balance must be $0; if a fee applies, the balance must be at least the fee.
steps.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

steps.do: Unlock and call the debit-card lookup for the account being closed
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: Unlock and call close_debit_card_4721 for each ACTIVE or PENDING card, with reason 'account_closing'
steps.if: the account has ACTIVE or PENDING debit cards
steps.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

steps.do: Tell the customer whether the early closure fee applies and about the notice period, then get their confirmation to proceed
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Unlock the closure tool
steps.if: all pre-closure requirements are met and the customer confirms
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Close the checking account
steps.if: all pre-closure requirements are met and the customer confirms
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Confirm the closure to the customer
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

rules.rule: The account status must be OPEN
rules.quote: Account status is OPEN

rules.rule: The account must have no pending transactions
rules.quote: No pending transactions for this account

rules.rule: Blue Account and Green Account (checking) are MID tier
rules.quote: MID TIER (Blue Account, Green Account (checking))

rules.rule: MID tier: $25 early closure fee only if closed within 60 days of date_opened; otherwise no fee, and the balance must be $0
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $25 if closed within 60 days

rules.rule: MID tier notice period is 3 days
rules.quote: Notice period: 3 days

rules.rule: The fee is deducted from the account balance; there is no other way to pay it
rules.quote: The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.

rules.rule: Debit cards linked to the account must be closed before the checking account
rules.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

jobs.done_when: close_bank_account_7392 has closed the requested checking account and the closure has been confirmed to the customer (after the savings account was opened, if both were requested).

documents.why: Procedure for opening a personal savings account: eligibility (including 14-day checking tenure), opening tool and funding options
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 for checking eligibility and pre-closure requirements
Procedure for closing a personal checking account: pre-closure requirements, MID tier fee and notice period, close_bank_account_7392
Debit cards must be closed before their linked checking account is closed; close_debit_card_4721 with reason account_closing
get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to find the cards linked to the account
Silver Plus: 15 free withdrawals, $2,500 minimum, daily compounding, $1,000 opening deposit
Silver Plus: 0.025% relationship bonus and ATM rebates up to 25 per month
Silver Plus: built-in savings goals tracking
Silver: only 10 free withdrawals, which rules it out
Eco option: only 8 free withdrawals, which rules it out
Premium Gold: $10,000 minimum, which rules it out
Platinum: $50,000 minimum, which rules it out

open_questions: The 3-day notice period for MID tier checking closure is listed, but no document says whether it delays the close_bank_account_7392 call or is only told to the customer.
The parameters of close_bank_account_7392 are not documented; the agent must read them after unlocking.
No document says whether closing a checking account affects a just-opened savings account that the customer has not funded yet.
The Silver Plus 'relationship criteria' are not defined in any document.
